releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.43 — the app is now yours offline. Every conversation is stored on the phone (one file per chat, newest 300 messages, per account, deleted with the chat), so it opens with its history instantly and stays readable with no network instead of going blank — the same local-first rule the chat list and friend list already used. Sending in airplane mode no longer turns the bubble red: the message waits in the outbox with its clock and goes out by itself the moment there is a connection. The app also watches the device's own internet state now (validated connection, not just "a network exists"): offline it parks the socket instead of dialling a dead radio, stops the fallback polling, prints "Waiting for network" in the chat header and the home banner — and the instant the network is back it re-dials, reports presence, flushes everything queued and resyncs the lists and the open conversations. Group chats opened offline are read and queued as groups too, from the cached chat list.
